claim: ADR 0299 rule 5. The restock export and page give the reason for a missing risk: a row with days of cover but no risk reads sold on fewer than N days in the window (N = params.minDemandDays), a row with no cover keeps no measured demand. The export names the order (highest measured risk first, then the fewest days of cover) in its restock table's title whenever a listed row has no risk. The page names it only in its line under a list cut short (more:, shown when reorderCount > the rows listed), and there only when a listed row has no risk; when every wine below its reorder point is listed, the page states no order. The page draws no bars when no listed row has a risk. ADR 0272 bars expression is kept byte-identical.
